p0: Verify every semantic hook from the reference contract exists exactly once.
Measure all reference zones using getBoundingClientRect and compare normalized x, y, width and height against their contract tolerance.

Assert the rocket does not intersect headline, supporting-copy or primary-cta. If its bounding box overlaps the navbar CTA, assert the filled amber CTA remains the top hit target and visually unobscured.
Assert headline has exactly two desktop lines and supporting copy has at most three desktop lines.
Assert page canvas resolves to #F8F8F6 and all visible hero text resolves to #0B0D11 or #4A4A4A. Assert accent usage is #FFC552 only.
Assert the desktop screenshot includes the CTA and full headline in the first viewport.
Assert mobile horizontal scroll width is not greater than viewport width and the CTA is visible before the rocket.
Assert reduced motion leaves headline, copy, CTA and rocket visible with no continuous animation.
Run Unified Quality Gate with no runtime, network, broken-image, overflow or clipping failure.
p1: Create a 50 percent opacity overlay of desktop screenshot and golden at 1586 by 992 scale.
Record global SSIM and different-pixel ratio for review. Pass only after visual reviewer confirms the macro composition is faithful.
Record computed font-family, font-size, line-height and color for brand, headline, copy and both CTAs.

resultSchema.failures: compact array of observable P0 or P1 failures only
resultSchema.measurements: normalized DOM rects, computed styles and image comparison metrics

releaseRule: A task cannot be approved by prose. It requires all P0 checks, evidence artifacts and a separate visual-review approval.
